items: 【Customizable RGB LED Mood Lighting】The bookshelf features an integrated light strip that can be controlled via a switch to freely adjust color, brightness, and transition speed. The switch offers multiple built-in lighting modes for various scenes including sunset, forest, birthday, and Christmas themes. You can also use the switch to customize your own lighting patterns for a personalized experience. No need for extra lamps-this shelf sets the mood.

【Stylish & Space-Saving Design】The small book case covers only 0.8 square feet, which is easy to move and organize. Ultra-narrow (only 7.1” wide) to fit snugly behind sofas, in room corners, or beside beds where other shelves can't. The combination with vintage wood panels creates a warm atmosphere and is perfect for living room, bedroom, home office, dining room and door way.

【Sturdy & Durable Construction】The corner bookcase is measured 15.8"L x 7.1"W x 43.3"H. Casaottima tree book shelves are constructed by premium metal frame & high-quality MDF board to ensure stability and durability as well as scratch and water resistance. Non-slip pads at the bottom further ensure the stability of the bookshelf.

【Large Storage Capacity】The narrow book shelf has 6 storage rack, each storage area can hold 5–10 books. The multifunctional partition design of the book case is perfect for displaying your books, CDs, magazines, video games, manga, decorations, novels, speakers and more. The open wooden frame at the bottom can be put into a storage box for storing small objects.

【Easy Assemble & Excellent Customer Service】The corner book case comes with detailed instructions, all parts are clearly labeled, what you need to do is following instructions step-by-step. If your book shelf arrives damaged, missing part or scratched, please feel free to contact us, our professional customer support team will help you solve the problem within 24 hours.
